final.title: Credential fields are not cleared after a failed sign-in
final.rationale: Both textboxes are located; after the wrong-password error is displayed they still contain the typed username and password. AC-3 requires both to be cleared for security. The error message part of AC-3 passes (SCN-003), so the fault is isolated to field clearing.
final.evidence: Reproduced live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3): after the error, Username='standard_user' and Password='wrong_password' remain — see runs/02-eval/confirm/SCN-004.png

error.headline: [REQ AC-7] Tax = 10% of Item total (pricing-rules.md)

entries.failingStep: And the Tax equals 10% of the Item total rounded half-up to 2 decimals

signals: Requirement assertion [REQ AC-7] failed on a located element.
auto.next: Confirm live in the AUT (reproduce the steps, observe the actual value), then record with --set.

final.title: Sales tax charged at 8% instead of the 10% in pricing-rules.md
final.rationale: Item total ($39.98 = $29.99 + $9.99) and Total = Item total + Tax both hold, isolating the fault to the tax rate: $3.20 is 8.0% of $39.98, while pricing-rules.md (attached to the story, owned by Finance) requires 10% → $4.00. Money is computed wrongly on every order.
final.evidence: Reproduced live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3) with the first two catalogue products: 'Item total: $39.98', 'Tax: $3.20', 'Total: $43.18' — see runs/02-eval/confirm/SCN-010.png
